specification.objective: After a successful required first-login password change or forgotten-password reset, take the user to login; keep the accessibility controls usable and bounded when changing text size.

requirements.statement: After changing a temporary password at first login, end the current authenticated session and display the login page.
Changing text size in the site accessibility panel does not cause the panel to expand beyond its viewport or show an unintended oversized inner surface.
After a successful forgotten-password reset, the reset success screen provides navigation to login and completes that navigation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A widget regression for a must-change-password session submits a successful change and verifies login is displayed, without the protected workspace or password-change page.
Accessibility widget regression changes text scaling to its maximum and verifies the panel remains within the viewport without layout exceptions.
A widget regression completes the forgotten-password reset success action and verifies login is displayed.
The byte-for-byte locked contract is stored at docs/contracts/password-accessibility-redirection-v1.polis.json.

invariants.statement: Never preserve an authenticated temporary-password session after successful password change when the user is meant to sign in again.
Do not change the reset password API, reset-token semantics, or unrelated authentication behavior.
Accessibility settings retain existing text scaling controls and reset behavior.

forbidden_states.statement: A user is redirected back to the required password-change page or into the protected workspace after changing the temporary password.
Text adjustment makes the accessibility panel exceed the viewport or triggers a layout exception.

inputs.statement: Accessibility panel state and user-requested text size adjustment.

outputs.statement: Login screen after successful password change/reset.
Accessibility panel with bounded viewport dimensions after text size adjustment.

failure_semantics.statement: If any regression fails, the declared proof command exits nonzero and prints password_accessibility_regression_missing.

argv: import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run(['flutter','test','test/widget_test.dart','test/accessibility_tools_test.dart'],cwd='frontend'); print('password_accessibility_regression_missing' if r.returncode else 'password_accessibility_regressions_pass'); sys.exit(r.returncode)
